name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: GTM Operations & CRM Automation Leader
summary: GTM operations leader and CRM architect with 15+ years across MarTech, SaaS, and agency environments, including 5+ years building CRM and marketing-automation systems hands-on. I own the systems layer of go-to-market: CRM architecture, pipeline stages, workflows, reporting, integrations, and data hygiene — then layer AI-assisted outbound on top, turning prompts, templates, and guardrails into personalized outreach that runs at scale. Equal parts RevOps discipline and builder's mindset.

Translate non-technical stakeholders' loosely-formed ideas into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions — the guardrails that keep automated outreach accurate, on-brand, and high quality at scale.

Lead evaluation, implementation, and integration of automation and enrichment tooling into client CRMs and CMS platforms, building reusable infrastructure for 24/7 automated growth engines.
